---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the SP 800-53 LinkML schema or its artefacts
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what went wrong.

**Where?**
The schema element, generated artefact (`project/...`) or release asset involved. A problem in the controls themselves belongs with [NIST](https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/risk-management/sp800-53-controls).

**To reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, including the exact command and input data.

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen, and the part of NIST SP 800-53, SP 800-53A or SP 800-53B that says so, if any.

## Environment

- OS:
- Python version (`uv run python --version`):
- `nist-sp-800-53` release, or the commit you built from:
- LinkML version (`uv run linkml --version`):

**Additional context**
Logs, tracebacks, or validation output.

## AI Assistance

If you used AI tools while preparing this issue, you are still the author and responsible for understanding, verifying, and defending your submission. Don't dump LLM output into this issue without curation. See the [AI Covenant](https://github.com/lmodel/nist-sp-800-53/blob/main/AI_COVENANT.md) for details.
